frozen_market.question: Will LeBron James be the #1 searched person on Google in the US this year?
frozen_market.exact_rule: Resolution source is Google’s official 2026 Year in Search United States People list; Yes only if LeBron James is rank #1 on that list. This is separate from Global Athletes, Search queries overall, Passings and absolute search volume. If 2026 list is not released by 2027-03-31 11:59 PM ET, rule says Other.

methodology.finding: Official method for 2025 only: fastest search-interest increase Jan 1–Nov 25, 2025 vs same 2024 dates, using Trends/internal tools; not absolute volume. People = trending living people; Passings is separate. Does not set 2024 or 2026 method/window.
